description:
MEASURED s344 (#231, docs/cpan-board14-partials-s344.md §A). 127 not-ok rows on the CPAN board — all 7 Sub-Uplevel PARTIAL files, of which 03_nested_uplevels.t alone is 103 rows. One root, several visible faces.

PROBED DIRECTLY (`sub f { my @c = caller; print scalar(@c), " [@c]" } f();`):
  perl: caller-n=3 [main p1.pl 2]        dollar0=p1.pl
  PCL : caller-n=4 [main /tmp/runpcl_23696.lisp 20 main::f]   dollar0=sbcl

 (a) `caller` with NO EXPR must return EXACTLY ($package,$filename,$line).
     PCL appends the sub name — that is caller(N)'s 4th field, not caller's.
     Anything doing `join " - ", caller` or `(caller)[2]` sees the wrong shape.
 (b) filename is the generated .lisp (or its ~/.pcl-cache copy), not the .pl/.t.
 (c) `$0` is "sbcl", not the script path.
 (d) `#line NN` directives are ignored (Sub-Uplevel 02: die reports the physical
     line 15 where perl reports the directive-adjusted 13).
 (e) *CORE::GLOBAL::caller overrides are not honoured (04/05_honor_*_override).
 (f) PCL's own frames are visible to a caller walk — 03_nested_uplevels gets
     `main, Call, …, Wrap, Sub::Uplevel` where perl gives `main, Call, …`; this
     is what makes uplevel() unable to hide frames.
 (g) caller(N) past the top of the stack returns a count, not an empty list
     (09_emptylist: got '4', expected '0').
 (h) NEW, probed s346 (found while probing #226; unrelated to it): the PACKAGE
     field is EMPTY inside an ANONYMOUS sub, correct inside a named one —
       sub named { my @c = caller(0); "[$c[0]]" }        # PCL [main]  = perl
       my $anon = sub { my @c = caller(0); "[$c[0]]" };  # PCL []      perl [main]
     So the per-sub caller frame that p-sub pushes is not pushed (or not
     populated with the package) by the anon-sub lambda wrapper.  Cheap, and
     independent of the frame-model design in (d)/(f).

(a)+(b)+(c)+(h) look independently cheap and are worth doing first — (a)-(c) are
also what Class-Method-Modifiers 060-caller.t wants (perl itself TODOs that row).
See docs/caller-implementation.md before touching the frame stack.

ALSO FOUND s346 (adjacent, NOT caller): `(sub { 42 })->()` — an anon sub
IMMEDIATELY called in expression position — dies "Not a CODE reference"
(p-funcall-ref receives the bare lambda, not a code ref).  Assigning to a
variable first works.  File separately if it does not fall out of the same fix.

DEFERRED (USER s488, 2026-09-17): not-supported.md entry "`caller()` fidelity [DEFERRED for now -- task #233]" covers the whole family; every baseline row citing #233 now carries `NS:caller() fidelity [DEFERRED, USER s488] +`.  Facts recorded there: no SBCL debug state is involved (PCL's own per-sub frame stack + the #1240 location registers); most items are a store per call; #line / frame hiding / CORE::GLOBAL::caller need design.  Re-open by USER decision only.

=== RE-PROBED (s539, Fable, 2026-11-12) -- raised with the USER as point 4 (docs/point4-decisions-s539.md section 2) ===
~/pcl-agent-scratch/s539/p4/c1.pl on main d1e98177: items (a) 4 fields, (b) the .lisp file and a Lisp line, (d) `# line` ignored, (h) empty frame in an anonymous sub all still stand; NEW: `(caller(0))[5]` (wantarray) is false in list context; `die` reports the right Perl file and line (#1240), so the data exists per frame and caller does not read it; croak still carries no location (#1361).  Board size today: 458 rows = SLU exotic_names.t 260 (no frame for an anonymous sub), Sub-Uplevel 123, Log-Log4perl 64 over 14 files, Template-Toolkit 8, Try-Tiny 3.  Proposed to the USER: tier 1 (file / line from the saved registers, 3 fields, empty list past the top, wantarray field, $0, an anonymous-sub frame, `#line` as a compile-time change of the register constants, Carp on caller) as one batch with a bench bar (sub-call and method-call rows inside the noise band, > 1 % flagged); tier 2 (frame hiding + CORE::GLOBAL::caller, about 110 rows; Test::Exception sits on Sub::Uplevel) designed when the widened board shows its size.
